name: Hayes With Nørbak, Oisel
description: This event features a lineup including Hayes, Nørbak, and Oisel. It is organized by Gare Porto and focuses on various techno music styles.
longDescription:
The event "Hayes With Nørbak, Oisel" is scheduled for Friday, November 13, 2026, at Gare Porto in Porto, Portugal. The music will start at 11:00 PM and continue until 6:00 AM.

The lineup includes Hayes, Nørbak, and Oisel, with Nørbak specifically mentioned. The musical styles for the night are Deep Techno, Dub Techno, Techno, Detroit Techno, and Hypnotic Techno.

Tickets are available for €10.00 for the first admission. Gare Porto, located at Rua da Madeira 182, 4000-330 Porto, is the organizer of this event.
